added_failure_note: The reviewed run recorded no baseline_suite/after_suite pair; its gate log reports 56 passed EXIT=0 at 7e2110b3 and its own negative control 1 failed EXIT=1, so no failures were added by the landed change.

findings.text: blocking: the declared power cap is in watts (profile.py:577 power_cap_watts, site tests declare 700 W) but conditions() uses it unsplit against a kilowatt figure, so cap_kilowatts and cap_percent are both 1000x wrong whenever a server declares a cap; reproduced against the landed module with a 420 W draw and a declared 700 W cap, which returns cap_kilowatts 700 and cap_percent 0.1 and renders "0.42 kW / 700.00 kW cap 0% of cap" where the truth is 0.70 kW and 60%.

non-blocking: _entry_for matches endpoints on host alone and discards the port, so two engines on one server both render the first endpoint's model, cards and port; reproduced with engines gpu-0003.iter.org:18810 and :18800, which both render "model deepseek-v4.1-flash cards 4xH200 port 18810", while the docstring at view.py:320 says the engine id's host:port is what is matched on.

non-blocking: the assertion compares the renderer's own NO_JOB constant against the output rather than against the literal the plan requires ("no job to sample"), so changing the constant keeps the test green while breaking the stated done-when; it is the same-variable shape the review contract asks to name.

non-blocking: orientation_base_sha 5f645391e563bc60ca632d9848ce178ade891 is not an object in this repository (the real base is 5f645391e563bc60ca632d9848cc4e1786ade891), so the record's own base attribution cannot be checked against git.
